Councils

UM has a University Council and six faculty councils, and NovUM is the only student party in Maastricht with councillors on every one of them. Wherever you study, a NovUM councillor speaks up for you.

Who represents me?

Pick your faculty and meet the students who represent you, in your faculty council and in the University Council.

Who can fix this?

Not sure where to go with a problem at UM? Pick what's going on and we'll show you who can help, step by step, and how your NovUM councillors can push for change.

General guidance: exact procedures can differ per faculty. Your study advisor can always point you in the right direction.

All seven councils

The University Council decides on matters for the whole university; each faculty council covers its own faculty. These are our councillors for this year.
